Principal dentist & oral surgeon

Dr Wale Towolawi

Dr Wale is the practice’s principal dentist. His published biography describes training in dentistry, medicine, oral surgery, implantology and clinical dermatology.

BDS, FDSRCS (Eng), MBBS (Lond), PG Dip Clin Derm (Lond)

GDC number published by the practice: 67657

Background & interests

After qualifying in dentistry at the University of Lagos in 1985, Dr Wale continued his training in the UK. He gained Fellowship of the Royal College of Surgeons of England in 1992 and qualified in medicine at Imperial College, University of London in 1998.

His practice biography describes further implantology training in 2000 and a postgraduate diploma in clinical dermatology in 2007. His clinical interests include oral surgery, implants and intravenous sedation.

Outside clinical work, his published interests include music, photography, computing, sport and travel.

Profile information: Wilton Dental Practice.
